scope: how Curio gets more views: niche outliers, platform distribution evidence, Curio first-party data
actions_taken: read-only research; nothing posted or changed; vidIQ credits used this round: 80 (1,701 -> 1,621)

first_party.claim: IG reels pass/fail: 4/12 at 1,941-2,692 plays, 8/12 at 133-268
Pushed reels all had 3-s skip <= 41.2%; none of 18 above were pushed
Full-frame + body at risk 4/5 broke out on YT; banded + body at risk 0/5
Body at risk: IG 3/4 pushed vs 1/8; all YT and FB breakouts

niche.claim: 40 core outliers (>=20x median) from 57 pulled; body topics 21/40; body/animal at risk 25/40
Hooks: 'What happens when/if...' 16/40; plain story line 14/40; number in first line 7/40
Length bimodal: <=15 s (9, mostly 11 s 3D mechanism or music-only text cards) and >120 s (10, 9 survival/history); 0 at 31-60 s (n=28 known)
3D in 19 of 30 known styles; no narrated letterboxed/banded outlier found (framing known for 6 only)
21/40 outliers from accounts under 10K followers; 6 under 1K
Growing accounts post ~0.5-4.5/day (Zack D ~4.5/day, yastor200 ~2/day, Lyrix 3D ~1/day)
Watched narrated outliers ran 2.2-2.5 words/s vs Curio 3.0-3.5

platform.claim: IG tests each reel on a small non-follower audience, then expands; ranking favours smaller creators
Top IG signals: watch time, likes, sends (sends weigh more for non-followers)
IG shows less of reels that are low-res, watermarked, muted, contain borders or are mostly text
Skip rate (first 3 s) replaced view rate
Trial Reels go to non-followers; auto-share if they perform in 72 h; Meta internal: 80% of users saw more non-follower reach
No YouTube penalty box; each video judged on its own
Facebook surfaces 50% more same-day Reels; original Reels get increased distribution
IG caps hashtags at 5; hashtags don't drive reach
Meta requires disclosure of realistic AI audio; no evidence the label reduces reach
YouTube 2025: templated/repetitive AI content not monetizable; distinct series fine
Awe +30%, practical value +30%, surprise +14% odds of virality (NYT most-emailed)
Too-vague curiosity-gap headlines backfire (8,977 Upworthy tests)
Posting more raises per-post reach on IG (+12% to +24%) with diminishing returns; on TikTok volume mostly raises top-10% outcomes

tests_preregistered.name: layout
tests_preregistered.design: banded v4 as normal post vs full-frame cut as Trial Reel, same day, 6 pairs
tests_preregistered.metric: plays at 72 h (+ skip rate if token refreshed)
tests_preregistered.decision: full-frame wins if better in >= 4/6 pairs

tests_preregistered.name: youtube restart
tests_preregistered.metric: views at 72 h, engaged views, viewed vs swiped
tests_preregistered.decision: compare to Sep 21-Oct 9 median 2,304 and Sep breakouts

tests_preregistered.name: shape
tests_preregistered.design: one 60-120 s survival story per week
tests_preregistered.decision: keep if beats daily median twice in a row
